description: The station record, its exits, its last-train times by line and direction (weekday, Saturday and Sunday; Seoul and Busan publish them; other cities answer last_trains as not_published), and (with "to") the walk from the station to a destination record. Takes the station name in common spellings (for example Myeong-dong, Hongik Univ., 명동역) or a place_id. Each exit carries its source and licence (OpenStreetMap, ODbL 1.0, in most cities; New York's entrances are MTA data).
name: get_station_exit
title: Get station exits
